verdict.rationale: PayPal's first-party docs describe webhooks as HTTPS POSTs from PayPal to your server endpoint whenever a subscribed event type occurs. Setup is done by subscribing a listening URL to an app, which is a registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is brief, though. missing for 10: event-type catalog detail, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks are HTTPS posts from PayPal to an endpoint on your server whenever the corresponding event type occurs
The initial setup for receiving webhooks is to subscribe a listening URL for a specific app
